$comment: Design context for 21st skills (21st-ui-explore / 21st-ui-build), written by hand because the 21st CLI is not signed in on this machine. Source of truth for values is src/app/globals.css; this file records them and the decisions taken in Shaun's section-by-section walk-through (from 6 Oct 2026).

stack.css: Tailwind v4 + hand-written globals.css (unlayered rules beat utilities)
stack.motion: CSS transitions and small rAF loops; Lenis smooth scroll on fine pointers; no motion runtime

commerce: Enquiry only: every product action is 'Enquire' / 'Ask for a price' to /enquiry. No basket, no checkout, no prices online.

tokens.palette_rule: Black and warm white, champagne gold as an accent only (a heading's key word, small icons, focus rings, the gold disc on pill buttons). No grey sections.

radius.note: Product photos sit in a 6px bezel with concentric inner corners (card radius minus 6px). Shaun, round 3: "dont make them so square".

motion.rules: transform/opacity/filter only; every animation has a reduced-motion state; backdrop blur only on fixed/sticky elements

constraints: Only S&L's own words and verified facts (content/*.json); no invented claims, ratings or prices
Product photos are S&L's own (public/images/pieces), no stars or sparkles on them
AA contrast; no horizontal scroll at 390 / 768 / 1440
Never touch the live site sl-jewellers-next or the BLA production branch

decisions.what: Services ('Bring it in. Get a price.') moved to /services with metallic-black pill actions; 'Shop by collection'; no starfield or photo stars; Visit lists every day with a black-and-white map; marquee heavier with dark edges and no gold.

decisions.notes: Utility strip (open now, address, phone) over a bar with the horizontal logo, every stocked category and a metallic Enquire pill. Sticks at -32px so the strip scrolls away. --hdr is 96px.
Huge numbered category words with counts; the photo follows hover/focus; shop links and contacts below. Focus moves in, Tab is trapped, Escape closes and returns focus.
The film with small corner type: what the shop does, the address, open now, a category rail and a scroll cue. Still no headline.
Shaun changed the wording to 'We sell gold, precious metals and watches.' (sections/Statement.tsx).
Watches as the large tile; slim text tiles for categories with no stock listed (sections/Collections.tsx).

decisions.chosen: A · New-in row, as a continuous marquee
decisions.notes: Shaun asked for the row to run as a marquee 'consistently going across the screen'. All 17 watches as product cards (Ask for a price, Enquire); pauses on hover, focus, off screen and with a button (sections/WatchShop.tsx, motion/CardMarquee.tsx).
Kept as built (sections/ServiceTiles.tsx), now with rounded cards, tags and CTA bar.
Shaun asked charcoal or rich black; rich black matches the product photos' ground (~#0a0a0a), so the cards blend into the page. Charcoal showed the photos as darker boxes.
No pick given; B and C stay on the preview switch until Shaun chooses.
Shaun: swipeable on a phone (cards follow the finger), no arrow buttons, an Instagram link (glyph + word, motion on hover) under it on the right (ReelsCarousel.tsx).

decisions.chosen: C · open now + week strip, with the black-and-white map on the left
rejected: A · Address + hours beside the map
decisions.notes: Map cut to the copy column's height, not C's tall photo (sections/Visit.tsx).
S&L's own stacked logo, small and centred; the cropped mark is no longer used there (Footer.tsx).

decisions.chosen: Stacked lock-up (crown and diamond over S&L jewellers)
decisions.notes: Shaun: the side-by-side cut 'is not the actual one'. Bar 80px (68px on phones) to give it room.

decisions.chosen: Centred list after Shaun's reference, photo on hover
decisions.notes: Every page as one large word in the middle, the others dim and the word's own photo floats by the pointer; hairline, address, hours, phone, bare icons (menu/SiteMenu.tsx, MenuHoverImage.tsx).

decisions.chosen: pending (A · text link shows by default)
decisions.notes: Shaun: the pill 'looks ridiculous'. Options on ?v=enquire: A text link, B hairline pill, C solid white pill.
